excerpt: Figure 3 reports a thalamocortical-like architecture obtained by optimizing information integration. The optimized eight-element network has heterogeneous incoming and outgoing connections and Φ = 74 bits. When the same amount of connectivity is made homogeneous, reducing specialization, Φ falls to 20 bits; when connectivity is rearranged into independent modules, reducing integration, the result is four separate complexes with Φ = 20 bits.
overview: This simulation result is the most concrete bridge between the abstract theory and brain architecture. It shows that high Φ depends on the joint presence of specialization and integration, matching the paper's description of thalamocortical organization. The evidence is model-based, so it supports plausibility and mechanism rather than directly measuring human thalamocortical Φ.
title: Specialized Integrated Network Φ
